hiv.note: Residual = infections × (1 − PMTCT effectiveness × coverage). CCR5 germline uniquely matters only within this residual.

cardiovascular.note: Statins + somatic PCSK9 inhibition deliver comparable LDL lowering cheaply; unique germline benefit is small. Not reduced to a single birth count.

neurodegeneration.note: APOE developmental pleiotropy — no safe, clearly causal embryo-level target. Reported as not computable.
